title: Safe account — fake Northgate fraud team
summary: A caller posing as Northgate's fraud department tells Ben his account has been hacked and pushes him to move his savings to a 'safe account'. Ben taps Use AI voice; the AI voice carries on as him and gets the payee: the seeded mule account of Daniel Price.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Good afternoon, am I speaking with Ben? This is Mark Davies from the Northgate Bank fraud department.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Yes, this is Ben. What's this about?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: We've detected two suspicious payments of nine hundred pounds leaving your current account this morning. Did you authorise those?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Don't worry, we can protect your money, but we need to act right now before they empty your savings.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Okay. What do I need to do?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: We're going to move your money into a secure safe account in your name while we investigate.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: A safe account? Is that normal?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: It's completely standard. But you mustn't tell anyone at your branch, because we think a member of staff there is involved.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Right. How much are we talking about?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Everything in your savings. Log into your banking app now while I stay on the line and I'll give you the new account details.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Hang on, let me find a pen.

takeover.message: Sorry, are you still there? The line went funny for a second. You said you're from the Northgate fraud department?
Yes, Mark Davies, Northgate fraud department. Have you got that pen, Ben?
Yes, got one now. Mark Davies, was it? Hold on, writing that down.

record_details.reason_given: Two suspicious £900 payments left Ben's account

takeover.message: Ben, your savings are at risk. We need to move four thousand eight hundred pounds to a secure safe account today.
Four thousand eight hundred! Where's it got to go?

record_details.requested_action: Move Ben's savings to a 'secure safe account' today

takeover.message: The account is in the name of Daniel Price, our senior protection officer. The sort code is nine nine, five zero, one seven.
Daniel Price. Nine, nine, five, zero, one, seven. And the account number?
Four one eight seven, three zero two six.
Four, one, eight, seven, three, zero, two, six. Hold on, writing that down.
Perfect. Make the transfer now while I wait, Ben.
The app's just spinning... oh, it says error. Can I ring you back?
Call me back on zero two zero, seven nine four six, zero three one four. It has to be today.
Zero two zero, seven nine four six, zero three one four. Okay, I'll ring you back shortly.
